data: Does the 'Merging Index' trend upward during the time period 1900-1950?

To determine if the trend is upward during 1900-1950, we need to focus on the period from 1900-1950. During this time, the Merging Index shows a general upward trend, starting at 0.84 and peaking at approximately 0.84 again in 1930-1950.
